title: Restricted single-complex cohomology and canonical pullback maps
statement: Let $h:Y\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $U\to S$ an etale scheme, $F$ an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $p\geq0$. Write $V=U\times_S Y$ [def-pc-fibre-product] and $r:V\to Y$. Define $R(h,F,U,p)=H^p(V,Q((r^{-1}F)[0]))$ using [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. For any scheme map $f:X\to Y$ and actual cochain complex $K$, define $P_p(f,K)$ by homology applied to the derived inverse-image/direct-image adjunction unit [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction], the right-derived global-sections composition isomorphism and mapDerivedCategoryFactors, exactly as in the parent presentation's hP equation. Given $a:Y'\to Y$, $h':Y'\to S$, $w:ah=h'$ and $\phi:a^{-1}F\to F'$, let $q:U\times_S Y'\to U\times_S Y$ be the pullback map. Its coefficient map $q^{-1}r^{-1}F\to r'^{-1}F'$ is the inverse composition comparison for $q,r$ followed by the comparison for $r',a$ [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] and $r'^{-1}\phi$. Define the map $R(h,F,U,p)\to R(h',F',U,p)$ by $P_p(q,(r^{-1}F)[0])$, the mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor comparison, and the single-complex coefficient map. These are actual formulas, with no data chosen from existence theorems.
